q1: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE JOIN (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE) AS A ON COURSE.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS
q2: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE JOIN (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE GROUP BY DEPT_NAME) AS A ON COURSE.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE JOIN (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE GROUP BY DEPT_NAME) AS A ON COURSE.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because Q1 finds the department(s) with the highest number of credits among all courses, while Q2 finds the department(s) with the highest number of credits among courses in each department.
counterexample_dsp: A department with a single course that has the highest number of credits among all courses in the university, but not the highest number of credits among courses in that department.
